South Indian Tamil Marriage Biodata & Jathagam Format Guide (திருமண பயோடேட்டா)

In Tamil Nadu and global Tamil communities, a Thirumana Biodata combines personal and career credentials with essential Jathagam (horoscope) attributes—specifically Kuladeivam, Gothram, Rasi, Natchathiram (Birth Star) with Padam, Lagnam, and Chevvai/Rahu-Kethu Dosham.

Biodata SectionEssential Fields & Cultural AttributesWhy Families Expect It
1. Auspicious Tamil InvocationPillaiyar Suzhi (உ) / ஸ்ரீ கணேசாய நமஹ / குலதெய்வம் துணை (Kuladeivam Thunai)Traditional South Indian auspicious header
2. Jathagam / Astrological ProfileDate & Exact Time of Birth, Place of Birth, Rasi (ராசி), Natchathiram (நட்சத்திரம்) & Padam, Gothram (கோத்திரம்), Kuladeivam (குலதெய்வம்), and Dosham statusEssential for 10 Porutham (Dasa Porutham) matching in Tamil matrimony
3. South Indian Rasi Chart Box12-Box South Indian Rasi / Lagna Chart (selectable in Studio & Kundali tab)Allows astrologers and families to inspect planetary houses directly on the biodata
4. Education, Career & FamilyQualification, IT/Core/Medical/Business Role, Work Location, Parents, Siblings, and Native District (e.g., Chennai, Madurai, Coimbatore, Thanjavur)Gives a complete picture of family heritage and professional standing

Frequently Asked Questions — Tamil Marriage Biodata (தமிழ் திருமண பயோடேட்டா)

Common questions about creating, customizing, and downloading your Tamil Marriage Biodata (தமிழ் திருமண பயோடேட்டா) in PDF, Word (.docx), and HD PNG formats.

Does this tool support South Indian Rasi Box charts for Tamil biodata?

Yes! In Tab 4 (Studio & Kundali), select "South Indian Rashi Box Grid" from the Kundali Chart Tradition dropdown to embed a traditional South Indian square Rasi chart on your biodata.

Can I include Kuladeivam, Natchathiram with Padam, and Chevvai Dosham?

Yes. The Horoscope section includes Rasi, Natchathiram, Charan/Padam, Gothram, Kuladeivam, and Dosham/Manglik fields in both Tamil (தமிழ்) and English.

Can I switch between Tamil script and English labels easily?

Yes. Use the Label Language selector to toggle between Tamil (தமிழ்) and English at any time without losing your typed answers.

Are Kanjeevaram Gold & Temple border templates included for free?

Yes, all 242 templates including Temple Arch, Lotus Mandala, and Kanjeevaram Gold designs are 100% free to download in PDF, Word (.docx), and PNG.
